meta.name: Cinder-Alloyed Plumb Chisel
meta.description: Forged by the master artisans of the Abyssal Hydro-Works, this tool fuses a standard plumb chisel with caustic-treated pewter gravel and cinder flux. By treating the quarry as a terraced chemical alembic, it applies a microscopic layer of vitriol to soften rock, significantly slowing durability drain. However, the caustic nature of the alloy means it cannot be repaired once broken.
meta.author: jules:session
